services.title: Carpet cleaning
services.short: Homes, offices and end of lease.
services.long: Hot water extraction carpet cleaning with truck-mounted machines and the right products, done to Australian and New Zealand standard 3733.

services.title: Wool carpet cleaning
services.short: Gentle on wool and wool blends.
services.long: As a WoolSafe Approved Service Provider, we use gentle products and methods made for wool and wool-blend carpets and rugs.

services.title: Upholstery & fabric protection
services.long: Upholstery cleaning that lifts body oils, sweat and everyday grime from fabric couches and chairs, with fabric protection available.

services.title: Leather cleaning
services.long: Leather furniture cleaned and conditioned to bring back its look and help it last longer.

services.title: Tile, grout & stone
services.long: High-pressure hot water and strong extraction lift dirt out of tiles and grout, followed by sealing for tiles, grout, natural stone and concrete.

services.title: Outdoor, pressure & office
services.long: Hot or cold pressure washing for driveways, paths and walls, outdoor cleaning for concrete and timber decks, and regular office cleaning.
